RECIPE (2026-08-27): shipped example + one extra row '| junk-rule [sic] | applied | file:code/src/demo.ts |' (resolving pointer, so no other layer speaks). Shipped build: exit 1, '✗ Architect · junk-rule [sic] — unknown rule (typo? not in runward/rules/)'. Mutated build: exit 0 — a fabricated rule name that happens to end in a bracket vanishes from the universe check and the gate goes green. A verdict flip to green on a row the operator can see in the file. Why nothing sees it: template placeholders match BOTH regexes so the legitimate skip is unchanged everywhere the net looks, and every foreign row any leg writes is a plain slug — all six full-net legs plus the self-gate replayed against the mutated build: PASS.

verdicts.evidence: Forcing the applied-guard true makes EVERY valid-status row with an empty Evidence cell collect 'applied without an evidence pointer — put a file:line or a test in the Evidence column'. It cannot flip a verdict — a row reaching this line is applied/deviated/n/a, and an empty cell already violates in each arm (applied: this same line; deviated: 'no ADR referenced'; n/a: trivial reason), so a green mission has no empty cell and MEASURED the shipped example is byte-identical — but on red missions the count and the lines move: on '| config-secrets-boundary | n/a |  |' the shipped build reports 1 violation (the n/a placeholder-reason one), the mutated build reports 2, gaps.conformance moves 1→2 in check --json, and the extra line instructs the operator to add a file:line to a row that is NOT applied — a remediation that contradicts the row's own declared status. ADR-0046 counts a changed count and a wrong remediation as a hole. Why nothing sees it: every exit code is unchanged, audit-corpus asserts exit codes only, smoke's scaffolded-row case still finds its strings; all six full-net legs plus the self-gate replayed against the mutated build: PASS.
